headline: Budget committee hears testimony on housing and police staffing, moves two meetings

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.summary: A testifier said affordable housing is needed in Hāna, and the budget includes $6.595 million to buy 7.2 acres for the project. A police lieutenant said Hāna has one or two officers on shift. South Maui moved to the 14th and West Maui to the 17th, both at 6 o'clock.
meeting.recap: The committee visits every district to hear testimony on the mayor's fiscal year 27 budget.[[0:00:48]] He said the group plans 25 homes, built five a year for five years.[[0:42:13]] He said a building permit that takes about three months in Lahaina is taking 330 days.[[0:43:03]] A testifier asked for $3 million from the Open Space Fund to buy about 115 acres at Hāneʻo.[[0:54:24]] A nonprofit board member said the Hāneʻo land was appraised at a little over $3.5 million.[[1:30:52]] A police lieutenant said Hāna sometimes has two officers on shift and sometimes one.[[1:44:31]] A council member said $20,000 for Hāna student travel is in the mayor's office budget.[[2:06:15]] The South Maui district meeting was moved to the 14th at 6 o'clock because of the weather.[[2:11:53]] The West Maui meeting was moved to the 17th at 6 o'clock.[[2:12:11]] The meeting was adjourned.[[2:12:49]]
meeting.next: The committee asked testifiers to submit their testimony in writing.

moments.q: Request for $3 million to buy Hāneʻo land

boards.name: Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

issues.oneLine: A new county emergency liaison for East Maui started work during the Kona storm on March 18.
issues.why: The liaison said it is important to keep a steady connection between the community and county emergency management.
issues.brief: A testifier thanked road crews, the water department and the electric company for their storm work.[[#1]] A testifier said many people went without electricity for over nine days.[[#2]] The liaison said she is working remotely and looking for office space.[[#3]]
